description: Monthly Hydropower Generation Dataset for Western Canada is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Youngjun Son, Cameron Bracken (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). The presented dataset contains the following simulation-based monthly hydropower generation data for 110 facilities in British Columbia and Alberta, to support Western-US interconnect grid system studies:1) Monthly hydropower generation estimates2) Monthly hydropower flexibility metrics (minimum and maximum hourly generation and daily fluctuations) The hydropower generation estimates are provided with reference to the facility list that ... Coverage: national (CA); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
